class.name: FoxJumpManager
class.brief_description: Component that manages the math, memory, and rules for jumping.
class.description: Tracks jump buffers, coyote time, and multi-jump charges without directly interacting with the character motor or physics body.

method.name: request
method.description: Registers a request to jump and starts the buffer timer.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels a pending jump request manually or when the buffer expires.

method.name: has_request
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a jump is currently buffered.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns true if a jump is legally allowed (grounded, coyote, or multi-jump).

method.name: consume
method.description: Clears the buffer, increments the jump counter, and records the timestamp.

method.name: reset_count
method.description: Resets the multi-jump counter to zero. Typically called when landing.

method.name: update_grounded_time
method.description: Records the exact millisecond the character was last touching the ground.

members.member: Maximum number of jumps allowed before landing (1 = Normal, 2 = Double Jump).
How long the player can still jump after walking off a ledge, in seconds.
How long a jump input is remembered before hitting the ground, in seconds.
The multiplier used for the jump force when jumping from a crouched position.

signal.name: consumed
signal.description: Emitted when a jump request is validated and consumed with [method consume].

signal.name: requested
signal.description: Emitted when a jump is requested with [method request].

signal.name: request_cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when a pending jump is cancelled with [method cancel].
